job.job_description:
Sr. Data Scientist

AI/ML Engineer

Role Summary

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to design and deliver AI-driven solutions across Computer Vision, Generative AI, and intelligent automation. The role combines visual AI, multimodal learning, LLM engineering, and cloud-native solution development to build scalable, enterprise-grade AI products.

Required Skills

4+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering.
Experience in Computer Vision including object detection, OCR, image analysis, and anomaly detection.
Hands-on experience with LLMs and foundation models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.).
Strong knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agent frameworks.
Experience designing and deploying cloud-native AI solutions.
Familiarity with solution architecture, APIs, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals.
Strong understanding of and experience in python programming

Preferred Skills

Experience with multimodal and vision-language models.
Exposure to MLOps and LLMOps practices.
Cloud solution architecture experience (AWS preferred).
Experience in intelligent test automation, quality engineering, or industrial AI use cases.
